prompt: Can you build me a Lynx UI settings screen with notification toggles, a theme radio group, and a save button? Please stay close to the official Lynx UI way instead of inventing a custom design system.
assertions: Treats the request as a screen-level composition problem rather than only a single component lookup
Composes the answer from official Lynx UI primitives such as ScrollView, Switch, RadioGroup, Input, or Button
Avoids inventing a generic React settings abstraction instead of using Lynx UI primitives
